inbox.no_mid: This mail has no Message-ID and cannot be opened here

picker.hint: Type to filter or create · 1–9 files directly
set.accounts.imap_gmail_proton_bridge: IMAP – Gmail, Proton Bridge, most providers
set.accounts.maillet_reads_mail_through: Maillet reads mail through Microsoft Graph with your own app registration – see . Whether you may allow it yourself is decided by your organisation: if Microsoft asks for admin approval, it is not allowed without your IT.
set.accounts.proton_mail_bridge_server: Proton Mail Bridge: server 127.0.0.1, port 1143, STARTTLS, accept self-signed certificate, and the bridge password shown in the Bridge app. Codes arrive up to ~40 s late – the Bridge polls Proton only every 20–40 s.
set.accounts.rules_are_assigned_to: Rules are assigned to this account by its tag. It stays the same when the account is renamed; renaming it here moves all its rules along.
set.actions.at_most_4_exits: At most 4 exits and 3 marks fit on a card; more go behind “⋯”. Done always sits in the corner.
set.actions.off_a_mail_stays: Off: a mail stays unread – and in the overview – until you mark it as read with the eye or move it on (Done, File, Task).
set.actions.opening_a_mail_marks: Opening a mail marks it as read
set.actions.targets_of_file_the: Targets of “File”. The order sets the keys 1–9. A new folder is created on the server on first use; you can also pick an existing one.
set.actions.what_mails_offer_on: What mails offer on hover and when reading. Exits take the mail out of the inbox and sit along the top of a card, marks keep it there and sit on the right. Keep your inbox empty? Turn off “Read / unread”.
set.api.local_http_endpoint_to: Local HTTP endpoint to show codes and links from outside, e.g. from a Tampermonkey script. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only; every request needs the token.
set.api.only_links_starting_with: Only links starting with one of these are shown, e.g. https://claude.ai/magic-link. Empty list = any https:// link is accepted.
set.catalog.preconfigured_rules_for_comm: Preconfigured rules for common services, loaded from the Maillet catalog on GitHub. + adds the rules of the selected language for all accounts, ▾ lets you pick accounts. They then appear under Rules.
set.general.language_of_the_maillet: Language of all Maillet windows, the tray menu and notifications.
set.general.opens_maillet_from_anywhere: Opens Maillet from anywhere and closes it again, in the form chosen under “Open as”. Click the field and press the keys you want; Backspace clears, Esc cancels.
set.general.the_inbox_view_shows: The inbox view shows the mails of the last days; older ones are loaded on request.
set.general.works_on_x11_desktops: Works on X11 desktops (Cinnamon, KDE, XFCE). On Wayland most desktops do not allow global shortcuts.
set.js.a_delete_hint: Moves the mail to the trash
set.js.a_done_hint: Moves the mail to the archive
set.js.a_file_hint: Moves the mail into a category (below)
set.js.a_noise_hint: Teaches Maillet which senders are newsletters
set.js.a_pin_hint: Star on the server, stays on top
set.js.a_read_hint: The mail stays in the inbox
set.js.a_task_hint: Moves the mail to the folder “Tasks”
set.js.body_hint: Text around the code, with {code}. Line breaks don't matter. Empty = first code-like word in the body.
set.js.body_small: (code is read from the mail text)
set.js.catalog_offline: GitHub not reachable – showing the last downloaded catalog.
set.js.choose_account_new: Choose at least one account for the new rules.
set.js.confirm_delete_account:
Delete the account “{name}”?
Its rules are kept; rules used only by this account are no longer checked.
set.js.confirm_token: Generate a new token? Scripts using the old token stop working.
set.js.hidden_rules: {n} rules with another sender not shown.
set.js.hidden_rules_one: 1 rule with another sender not shown.
set.js.kind_code_hint: Detects a code and shows it large for copying. The body is only downloaded when sender and subject already match.
set.js.kind_link_hint: Detects a login link (e.g. a magic link) in the body and offers it for opening.
set.js.link_hint: The first link in the mail body starting with this text is offered for opening. Be specific (domain and path) – only matching links are ever opened.
set.js.mark_code_hint: Mark the code in the subject with {code}, or describe it in the body.
set.js.name: Name
set.js.no_accounts:
No accounts configured.
Click “+ Add account” to get started.
set.js.no_rules:
No rules yet.
Add one with “+ New rule” or take rules from the Catalog.
set.js.nothing_to_import: Nothing to import – all selected rules are already up to date.
set.js.pv_prev: Could you look through it by Friday?
set.js.remove_cat: Remove (the folder and its mails stay on the server)
set.js.rule_saved: Rule saved – active from the next mail check.
set.js.sc_na_hint: another program may use it, try a different one.
set.js.sc_need_mod: Use Ctrl, Alt or Super with the key
set.js.sc_off_ph: Off – click to record a shortcut
set.js.sender_hint: Comma-separated, * = any text. Empty = any sender.
set.js.stay_unread: Mails stay unread until you decide
set.js.subject: Subject
set.js.subject_code_hint: Write the subject as it arrives, put {code} where the code is and * for changing text. Case is ignored. Without {code} the code is read from the body.
set.js.subject_link_hint: Write the subject as it arrives, * for changing text. Case is ignored. Empty = any subject (then a sender is required).
set.js.suggest_hint: An app entry for catalog/catalog.json. Only suggest rules you checked against a real mail. If the service is already in the catalog, add the rule to its variants instead.
set.js.timings: After the server reported the mail: headers {h} ms{b} · done {d} ms
set.js.unverified_tip: Not yet checked against a real mail – please test before relying on it
set.js.win_both: This holds for the tray icon and the shortcut alike.
set.js.win_popup_hint: The popup sits at the tray icon and hides when you click elsewhere, unless pinned.
set.js.win_sidebar_hint: The sidebar takes the full height of the screen at the side of the tray icon (or the edge you pick) and goes behind other windows when you click elsewhere, unless pinned.
set.log.kept_in_memory_only: Kept in memory only (last 500 entries), never written to disk. Mail text is not stored; codes are masked – click to reveal. Links are cut after their path.
set.notifications.desktop_notification_f: Desktop notification for new mails from people
set.notifications.newsletters_bulk_mail_: Newsletters, bulk mail and login codes never notify. A click on the notification opens the mail; a burst of mails is collapsed into one notification.
set.notifications.otherwise_all_unread_m: Otherwise all unread mails count, including newsletters.
set.notifications.tray_icon_counts_only: Tray icon counts only mails from people
set.rules.or_choose_a_file: Or <button class="link" onclick="importFromFile()">choose a file…</button> Rules with the same name are updated; their accounts, active state and position stay as they are.
set.rules.rules_are_checked_from: Rules are checked from top to bottom; the first match wins. An account without rules uses the built-in rule {code} is your verification code.
set.rules.rules_as_json_from: Rules as JSON <small>(from an Maillet export)</small>
set.theme.colour_theme_and_style: Colour theme and style of all Maillet windows, the same choice as in every be spex app. A click applies it at once.
status.tagline: new mail at a glance, right in the tray
tasks.back_tip: No longer a task – back to the inbox
toast.is_person: {a} is now treated as a person
toast.no_mid: This mail has no Message-ID and cannot be moved
toast.not_found: Mail not found any more – it is still in the target folder
toast.pinned: Pinned – starred on the server too
